title: Stop making this roaming mistake
description: How to recognize when leaving your lane actually gives the opponent an advantage.
takeaways: If the wave is pushing into you, a roam donates plates and XP.
Ping the roam 8 seconds early or your jungler cannot follow.
Crash a cannon wave first — never leave a slow push to die under tower.

title: How to punish Zed after he uses W
description: The exact window to trade, shove, or all-in once Zed's shadow is spent.
takeaways: W is his only safe disengage — once it's down, walk up.
Hold your charm for the shadow, not the first auto.
If he uses W to farm, crash the wave and deny the bounce.

title: 3 mistakes every Silver ADC makes
description: The spacing, wave, and fight-selection errors that keep bot lane stuck in Silver.
takeaways: Don't auto the wave while the enemy ADC is looking to trade.
Crash before dragon — never recall on a slow push.
If your support is not there, you are not in a 2v2. Leave.

title: Stop taking this fight as a Jungler
description: How to read tempo so you invade or path away instead of donating a kill.
takeaways: If your bot has no prio, the river fight is not yours.
Track the enemy's second camp — that's when they're actually gankable.
A full clear into a losing 3v3 is how games get thrown at 3:30.

title: The Ahri combo you're dropping in lane
description: How to land charm after orb without flashing it on a minion.
takeaways: Q first only if the wave is already shoved — otherwise you lose the charm angle.
Walk off-center before E so they can't sidestep with the minion block.
Save W for the charm connect, not the approach.

title: Wave management before you roam
description: The three wave states — and which one is the only one you should leave.
takeaways: Slow push, crash, bounce. Roam on the crash, never on the bounce.
If they freeze, you don't roam — you thin and hold.
Cannon waves are timers. Use them.

title: Land Lux root from fog every time
description: How to catch the dash-heavy mid laner without telegraphing the Q.
takeaways: Throw Q from a brush or after a cannon last-hit animation.
E first only if you need vision — otherwise you show the play.
Flash Q is for when they used their dash, not before.

title: When grouping mid actually throws
description: How to tell a real 5-man play from four people standing mid while the side wave dies.
takeaways: Group for a Herald or a set-up pick — not because the chat said mid.
If the side wave will hit tower in 15 seconds, you are late.
The player with the strongest side wave stays. Everyone else rotates.
